verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 120.2 (+2.7% in a day) and momentum is 42: prices are falling. 84s cost 850, 85s 2,800 and 86s 5,000. It is Champions weekend, when meta cards usually sell best.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-10-31T07:30:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Taylor Flint 85 Ultimate Scream after its 12% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 70,500 coins. Now 71,500. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 11.9% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 2 of 4 so far, averaging +2.8% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Sell Sergej Milinković-Savić 85 Team of the week after its 73% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 13,000 coins. Now 15,000. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 72.9% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 2 of 4 so far, averaging +2.8% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Champions weekend: sell spare meta cards, keep the ones you play
moves.detail: Meta cards usually sell best during the weekend. Selling and rebuying cards you play costs the 5% tax and a higher weekend price.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 850 (1.02 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,800 (1.33 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,000 (1.22 coins per Item Score point), 87s 7,000 (1.27 coins per Item Score point), 88s 12,500 (1.51 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 86s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Dominik Szoboszlai and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Dominik Szoboszlai 86 Rare -57.6%; Konstantinos Karetsas 76 Rare -39.3%; Dirk Kuyt 86 Base Hero -17.4%; Deyna Castellanos 78 Rare -15.6%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: Ramiro Árciga SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 6.4K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
